english.progress: The helm of the Dragonslayer once belonged to a great commander who fell in battle. It is said his tormented soul still haunts the site of his passing.
english.complete: Splendid job, <name>! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.

english.title: High Sorcerer Andromath
english.detail:
High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, <name>.  He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.

It would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in Dalaran.  Council with him is high council indeed.
english.complete: Greetings, <name>.  I am pleased to see you, and hope you have time to listen to an old man's words...

english.title: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
english.detail:
Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts.  He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist.  And so he was banished.

The fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book--Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.

We, the mages of Stormwind, would have that book returned.  Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.
english.objective: Bring Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic to High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind.
english.progress: Do you have the book, <name>?  Its secrets are not meant for the untrained, and plumbing its depths can lead to doom and ruin.
english.complete:
I feared that Morganth had hidden the book elsewhere, or that he had found a way to open it and read its contents.

It is good to see that he did not, and that the seals we placed on Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic still hold.

english.title: Pristine Spider Silk
english.detail:
Your service has been unwavering, <name>.  I think, perhaps, it is time you had a finer garment, one more suiting your station as an adept mage.  If you gather the needed materials, then we will arrange the robe made.

You must enter Duskwood and hunt carrion recluse spiders.  Extract their silk, but only the finest, most pristine silk will do.  When you have enough, take it to Wynne Larson, here in the mage district at the Larson Clothiers.  She will craft your robe.
english.objective: Bring 8 Pristine Spider Silk to Wynne Larson in Stormwind.
english.progress: Ah, yes.  The mages of the Wizard's Sanctum said you'd speak with me.  Do you have the required silk?
english.complete: Nice specimens, these.  I'll get right to work!

english.title: Astral Knot Garment
english.complete:
Your garment is ready!  And that silk you gathered was so nice... you don't mind if I made it a little short so that I'd have some silk left over for me, do you?

I'm only joking.  It'll fit you great, and will be perfect for both adventure and formal dining.  Enjoy!

english.title: Speak with Deino
english.detail: The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, <name>.  She resides in Orgrimmar, in the Darkbriar Lodge.
english.complete: Good, you have come.  My task is not an easy one, but vital to the society of mages.  If you aid me, I am sure you will find it worthwhile.

english.title: Waters of Xavian
english.detail:
The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned.  It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.

I would have a sample of those waters, from their source.

Take this flask and go to Xavian.  Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me.  And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.
english.objective: Bring the Xavian Water Sample to Deino in Orgrimmar.
english.progress: I am pleased you have returned with your skin intact, <name>.  Do you have the water sample?  I am eager to study its properties.
english.complete:
Ah, very good.  I trust the satyrs of Xavian gave you little trouble?

Thank you, <name>.  I will study this sample of Xavian water immediately.

english.title: Laughing Sisters
english.detail:
For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...

For these robes, you must return to Ashenvale for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.

When you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens.  He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.
english.objective: Bring 12 Laughing Sister's Hairs to Kil'hala at the Crossroads.
english.progress: Greetings, <name>.  Deino said you would come, and would bring the laughing sisters' hair.  Do you have it?
english.complete:
Ah, this hair will weave into a fine robe, <name>.  It is a pity the laughing sisters had to die to part with it, though I do doubt they would ever give it willingly.

A pity, but only a small one.

english.title: Nether-lace Garment
english.complete:
Here is your nether-lace, <name>.  It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair.

Enjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino.  She is a <class> on whose good side I wish to stay...
